_prototype: PROTOTYPE - flavor sandbox (joey_sandbox_v2). Controls how often the F7 prose narrator speaks. Not reviewed by Max. Default profile reproduces pre-prototype behaviour exactly.
_howToUse: Set activeProfile to any key under profiles. 'full' = pre-prototype behaviour. 'sparse' = decision 4 pacing. paragraphTargetMs 0 leaves the shipping 8000ms budget alone.

full._note: Pre-prototype behaviour. Every eligible step speaks on every swing.

sparse._note: Ledger + highlight. The sequence* per-step prose is demoted to near-silence (swingChance 0.18, one sentence) because it narrates the exchange, not the turn. narratorEnabled routes the one-shot banks back in, tiered by significance.
